about_the_game:
Game Features:

Face various types of enemies.

Enhance yourself using acquired resources

Complete missions to gain new skills

Survive until the end to defeat the boss

Unlock new levels and storylines

Includes 18 levels set in different environments (Demo contains 6 level)

36 unique enemies and bosses

15 unlockable skills

Sci-fi-inspired Journey to the West setting

Fight for the future of Mount Hua Guo!

short_description: Wukong 2088 is a survival rogue-like game where you play as the secret weapon of Sun Wukong in a sci-fi version of Journey to the West. You will resist the invasion of Tiangong, face continuous waves of enemies and bosses, defeat them, and strengthen yourself to fight against the powerful Mega-Corp.

English, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
